data.name: Amena
data.gender_notes: Amena is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word ‘amēn,’ meaning ‘truly,’ ‘so be it.’ In Christianity, Amena is a feminine variation of the word ‘Amen,’ which is used as a response to prayers and blessings. Amena represents faithfulness, reliability, and trustworthiness. The name Amena carries the meaning “Faithful, reliable” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Amena usually hope their child will grow to embody faithful, reliable and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Amena belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Faithful, reliable.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Amena total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
